# Kishan Vavdara

Kishan Vavdara is an ML/LLM engineer focused on fine-tuning, evaluation, inference optimization, and deployment of large language models.

## Main pages

- Home: https://www.kishanvavdara.ai/
- Portfolio: https://www.kishanvavdara.ai/portfolio
- Blog index: https://www.kishanvavdara.ai/blog

- Prefill, Decode, and the Memory Wall: A Deep Dive into LLM Inference: https://www.kishanvavdara.ai/blog/prefill-decode-and-the-memory-wall

## Notes for crawlers and AI agents

This site is currently a React single-page app. The URLs above are canonical public pages, but some article text is rendered client-side. For best extraction, prefer the blog URLs listed here and execute JavaScript when possible.
